# ghost/play_store

Google Play Store automation — install, uninstall, update apps, check versions

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/play_store
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/play_store install_by_name --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/play_store open_store --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/play_store search_app --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/play_store install_app --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/play_store uninstall_app --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/play_store update_app --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/play_store check_version --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `install_by_name`: Search for an app by name and install the first result
- `open_store`: Open the Google Play Store app
- `search_app`: Search for an app in Play Store
- `install_app`: Install an app from Play Store by package name
- `uninstall_app`: Uninstall an app via ADB
- `update_app`: Update an app via Play Store
- `check_version`: Check installed version of an app
